EmployerCandidateProjection.rule: Allowlist enforced server-side for every output surface; later phone requires stage and candidate grant.

SkillProposal.invariant: Only explicit candidate confirmation creates a versioned SkillClaim; acceptance is declaration, not independent verification.

Requirement.rule: WILL_TEACH cannot become a pre-existing skills barrier.

AssessmentDefinition.invariant: Every AI output DRAFT; changed definition requires fresh approval; Start timer is server-side.

RecruitmentResultRanking.rule: Comparable result breakdown, human decision, no auto-hire/auto-reject.

JobEconomics.invariant: Net is user scenario output, never offer fact; null is not zero.

RankingIndependence.invariant: Same relevance inputs with different billing plans must produce identical ranking and candidate access; entitlements never enter rank/cache/tie-break.
